objects.taxonomy_description: Equine mammal measuring 140-170 cm at withers with athletic build. Coat uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coloration with no black points. Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen). Head elongated with large expressive eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched and muscular. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs long and slender with single hoof per foot. Tail long with flowing hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Color variant of horse distinguished by reddish-brown coat.

Head_and_Face: Elongated head with large expressive eyes and mobile ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Athletic build with tall, lean proportions at the withers.
Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.
Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.

objects.taxonomy_description: An inanimate manufactured object designed for play, distinguished from living organisms by artificial materials and lack of biological structures.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Composition: Surface exhibits synthetic textures such as molded plastic, plush fabric, or painted finishes rather than organic skin, fur, or scales.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Anatomy: Lacks functional biological features such as eyes with pupils, nostrils, mouths, or jointed limbs capable of natural movement.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Manufacturing_Markers: Displays signs of industrial production including visible seam lines, mold marks, uniform coloration, or attached tags and labels.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Proportional_Artificiality: Body proportions are often stylized, exaggerated, or simplified for aesthetic or ergonomic purposes rather than adhering to natural anatomical ratios.
